_comment: Hand-maintained record of brick catalogue occupancy & connector tasks: done, investigated & rejected, and pending. Priority order: real_set_impact on named priority sets > catalogue_wide_impact > confidence.

items.note: Minifig head, headwear, hair, and accessories anatomy classification.
Bar grip detection (extremity + isolation) and bars connector emission.
TYRE_PARTS occupancy family (inscribed square in outer circle).
True hinges require pose parameter / dynamic joint model; fixed static occupancy impossible without false collisions. Solved as hinges connector matcher instead.
WHEEL_PARTS occupancy family with 4-box central bore exclusion.
SLOPE_PARTS occupancy family extension.
Generic tile occupancy and printed/decorated variant unlock.
PANEL_FLAT_WALL_PARTS occupancy family.
TECHNIC_GEAR_PARTS occupancy family with 4-box axle bore exclusion.
OBB + 15-axis SAT collision geometry in Python.
Continuous rotation wiring in OMR importer.
OBB + SAT collision geometry ported to JavaScript twin.
Curved 3D compound surfaces, hollow cockpits, and thin non-uniform glass shells mean no axis-aligned box can clear solid fraction floor without severe empty-space overclaims.
WHEEL_PARTS extended to 15 more real wheel rims catalogue-wide.
Thin curved shells (1-2 LDU thick) with extensive hollow cutouts and multi-axis mounting holes fail minimum solid fraction; boxing would cause false collisions.
Organic sculpted creature meshes lack shared geometric invariants; boxing would falsely collide with minifig hands and mounts.
Survey of remaining Technic parts; pin overrides 61184 and 89678 added; bushes and complex linkages rejected.
Minifig torso occupancy and printed variant unlock.
Plain Technic axles (3704-50450) and with-stop variants (24316, 87083, etc.) implemented with two-box decomposition.

Coaxial axle-pin hybrids (43093, 11214, 18651, 3749). Single largest remaining piece count on priority set H175 (42145) with 163 instances. High confidence: rigid coaxial pin+axle geometry with well-defined shaft and flange bounds.
items.catalogue_wide_impact: Used across hundreds of official Technic sets

items.note: Technic Cross Blocks (6536 90° 1x2 Axle/Pin, 32184 1x3 Two Axle Holes, 42003 1x3, 32291, 63869). Total 149 instances in H175. Medium confidence: multi-axis pin/axle holes make solid fraction and collision bounds tricky.
Moving mechanisms, motors, turntables, universal joints, linear actuators in H175 (42145). Low confidence: real moving mechanisms and electronics are unlikely to be safely boxable.
